summary: Create keyframed animation curves on a project or clip property (position, scale, rotation, opacity) with linear, bezier or constant interpolation, stored in the project revision and exported through the OTIO gen metadata channel.

inputs.name: project
inputs.constraints: the timeline carrying the target clip

outputs.name: updatedProject
outputs.constraints: new immutable project revision carrying the curve

parameters.name: keyframes
parameters.description: Keyframes as t=v;t=v;... with t in seconds and v the property value.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target clip name, or the literal 'project' for project-level curves.

qualityDimensions.description: Round-trip preservation of key times, values and interpolation through native formats.
Which interpolation modes the native format realizes natively vs approximates.

costModel.notes: Pure project operation; cost realized at render time.

providerMappings.notes: Generated bpy script inserts fcurves/keyframes on VSE strips at the scene fps grid. Live conformance skipped in Phase 1 sandbox (blender binary absent); structural OTIO round-trip verified.

notes: Launch descriptor (draft per lock §7). Only Blender maps this capability in the launch set; other launch editors have no shared curve container in their declared headless subsets.
